The safety database includes a total of 588 participants who received at least one dose of CT-P43 (208 healthy individuals and 380 subjects with PsO).
Healthy subjects: 602 participants received a single dose of 45 mg/0.5mL product subcutaneously.
o CT-P43, n=208 (n=14, evaluated up to Day 29; n=80, evaluated up to Day 127; n=114, evaluated up to Day 113)

Subjects with psoriasis: 509 subjects received at least one dose of 45mg/0.5mL product subcutaneously followed by another dose 4 weeks later, and then every 12 weeks thereafter up to Week 40. Those receiving EU-Stelara were re-randomized 1:1 to receive either CT-P43 or EU-Stelara at Week 16.

Median treatment durations were comparable across the treatment groups in Study CT-P43 3.1 (Table 18). A similar proportion of subjects in the CT-P43 treatment group received all 5 doses of the study medication (95.3%), compared to the EU-Stelara (96.8%) group. The mean number of doses received was 5.0 for the EU-Stelara (TP1) - EU-Stelara (TP2) and EU-Stelara (TP1) - CT-P43 (TP2) treatment groups and 4.9 for the CT-P43 (TP1) – CT-P43 (TP2) groups.
